create_ensemble: create an Ensemble ENN that wraps a Haiku Transformed model with a configurable number of ensemble members
create_ensemble_with_state: create an EnsembleWithState ENN that wraps a Haiku TransformedWithState model with stateful ensemble members
build_mlp_ensemble_prior_fns: build an ensemble of MLP prior functions with configurable output sizes, seed, and weight initializers
combine_functions_choice_via_index: combine prior functions into a PriorFn that selects one function by ensemble index using lax.switch
create_mlp_ensemble_matched_prior: create an MLPEnsembleMatchedPrior ENN that combines an MLP ensemble with matched prior functions and additive prior
